chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abbas from Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala' from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the ritual bath (ghusl) when I visit the House (Kaaba) from Mina, so he said: 'I bathe in Mina, then I visit the House.'
ai.seo_question: When should one perform the ritual bath (ghusl) in relation to visiting the Kaaba during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies the location and sequence of the ritual bath (ghusl) during the Hajj, performing it in Mina before visiting the Kaaba. This establishes a preferred Sunnah for pilgrims, linking the purification in the tent city with the subsequent veneration of the House, reflecting the holistic spiritual preparation required for the rites of Hajj.
